description: Focused capability verification of the six Negotiation-T fromData interfaces. The private-line complaint Task-T template is the business source of truth: 任务对象、投诉分类、OSS侧事件流水号 are required; 问题发生时间、投诉详情 are optional and their absence must never initiate negotiation. Propose covers all seven non-empty combinations of the three required fields plus the empty boundary. Multiple top-level fields have an AND relationship; a single field has a null relationship; the three alternative representations inside 任务对象 have an OR relationship. Accept returns real values for requested required fields, while Reject returns an itemized reason containing 无法提供. Generation checks message values; validation extracts the exact field-name list, accept/reject payloads, and relationship through the shared InformationNegotiationSchemas contracts (items:[{name, requirement|value|reason}]) also used by the fromText samples.
